title: Generate Study Notes from Any Material
description: Use AI to transform textbooks, papers, podcasts (transcribed), or lecture notes into high-quality study material.
steps: Choose a chapter or section you need to learn (paste or upload it)
Prompt 1: "Summarize this material into: key concepts (bullet), important definitions, and 3 things I absolutely must remember"
Prompt 2: "Generate 10 quiz questions from this content — mix multiple choice and short answer"
Prompt 3: "Create a one-page cheat sheet with the most important information formatted for quick review"
Test yourself with the quiz questions before looking at answers
expectedOutput: A study pack: concept summary, quiz questions, and a one-page reference cheat sheet.
bonusChallenges: Ask AI to create an analogy that maps this material to something you already know well
Have AI generate "common misconceptions" for the topic to pre-empt mistakes
